question: Should LiteLLM interactive onboarding grow its own proxy base-URL prompt and model-discovery step, or should remote LiteLLM users be directed to Custom Provider and broader dynamic catalog work?
rationale: Both paths can solve the report, but the choice changes provider-owned onboarding UX, credentialed endpoint probing policy, and the boundary between bundled LiteLLM setup and generic OpenAI-compatible custom providers.

options.title: Add LiteLLM URL Prompt
options.body: Have litellm-api-key ask for or confirm the proxy base URL before model selection while preserving the non-interactive --custom-base-url path.

options.title: Route To Custom Provider
options.body: Keep LiteLLM as localhost/default-model setup and update prompts or docs so remote proxy users choose Custom Provider for URL and model setup.

options.title: Defer To Dynamic Catalog
options.body: Leave this issue open until the broader live provider catalog and credentialed discovery policy is settled.

recommendation.title: Add LiteLLM URL Prompt
recommendation.body: Have litellm-api-key ask for or confirm the proxy base URL before model selection while preserving the non-interactive --custom-base-url path.

likelyOwner.reason: The current LiteLLM plugin setup boundary and guided onboarding refactor route the product decision most directly through steipete's recent work.
